tls:skip render (raw_tls_skip_hops): with the delta present, the two OneCLI proxy CONNECT-tunnel hops 172.17.0.1:18255 (proxy_addr) and 172.17.0.1:18777 (broker_addr) render as raw passthrough endpoints {host, port, tls: skip} with NO protocol/enforcement/rules (a protocol:rest POST /** rule would break the opaque tunnel; operator-validated 0.0.72 shape). inference-api.nvidia.com:443 is a real HTTP-API endpoint and KEEPS protocol:rest/enforcement:enforce with its POST /** rule. The tls:skip shape is keyed strictly on the delta being present, never inferred from the allow-set.
